0 1 3
7 8 2
4 6 5

Goal board:
1 2 3
4 5 6
7 8 0

You may reason step by step first. Then END your reply with exactly one JSON object on its own line and nothing after it, in this format:
{"moves": ["UP", "LEFT", ...], "cost": <total cost as an integer>}
